channel.title: FlowCook
channel.description: Automation recipes that just work when you follow them. Tested on a real setup.

item.title: A Weekly AI Spend Report So API Bills Never Sneak Up
item.description: A weekly job checks your LLM provider dashboard and sends a short summary of last week's usage and cost — with a strict no-guessing rule.

item.title: One-Shot Countdown Reminders for Big-Event Prep (D-90, D-60, D-30)
item.description: Schedule one-time reminders at 90, 60, and 30 days before a trip or deadline — each message names the exact next action, so nothing slips.

item.title: Get Tomorrow's Schedule the Night Before — Silent When Empty
item.description: A nightly job reads your calendar and messages you tomorrow's events. If there is nothing scheduled, it stays completely silent.

item.title: Turn One Blog Post into a Ready-to-Post Social Thread
item.description: Give the agent a finished article and get back a social thread draft in your voice — hook, key points, and a call to read more.

item.title: Turn Meeting Transcripts into Minutes with Action Items
item.description: Feed a meeting transcript to your agent and get structured minutes: decisions, action items with owners, and open questions.

item.title: One Daily Digest for Your GitHub Repos
item.description: Instead of notification spam, get one digest a day: new issues, PRs awaiting review, and CI failures across your repos.

item.title: Disk Space Watchdog That Only Speaks When It Hurts
item.description: A cron job checks disk usage and alerts only when a partition crosses your threshold — silent otherwise.

item.title: Extract Text and Tables from Korean HWP Files
item.description: Read .hwp / .hwpx documents (the Korean standard format) with an open-source library and pull out clean text.

item.title: Summarize Any YouTube Video Before Watching It
item.description: Fetch a video transcript and get a structured summary — key points, timestamps, and whether it is worth your time.

item.title: Track Your Favorite Blogs Without Opening Them
item.description: Subscribe to a list of blogs and RSS feeds, and receive one digest a day with only the new posts.

item.title: Watch a Product Price and Get Alerted at Your Target
item.description: A scheduled job checks a product page every few hours and messages you the moment the price drops below your target.

item.title: Two-Way Sync Between Google Drive and a Local Folder
item.description: A script that keeps a local folder and a Google Drive folder in sync, both ways, on a schedule.

item.title: Get a Daily Morning News Briefing on Telegram
item.description: A cron job collects global and local news every morning, summarizes it, and delivers it to Telegram.
